entries.title: I Corinthians 10:1
segments: For I would not have you ignorant, brothers, how our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea,

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:2
segments: and all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:3
segments: They all ate of the same spiritual bread,

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:4
segments: and all drank from the same spiritual stream, for they were drinking from a spiritual rock that followed them, and that Rock was Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:5
segments: But in most of them God was not well pleased, for they were laid low in the desert.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:6
segments: Now this happened as a warning for us, that we might not long for evil things as they longed.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:7
segments: And you must not be idolaters like some of them: as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, And they rose up for idol dances.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:8
segments: Nor must we act licentiously, as some of them did, and fell in a single day, twenty-three thousand of them.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:9
segments: Neither must we presume upon the patience of our Lord, as some of them presumed, and were destroyed by the serpents;

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:10
segments: nor murmur, as some of them did, and were destroyed by the Destroying Angel.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:11
segments: Now these things were happening to them typically, but were written down for our admonition who stand at the meeting of the ages.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:12
segments: So then let him who imagines that he is standing so securely beware lest he fall.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:13
segments: No temptation has overtaken you that is beyond man's power; but God is faithful, who will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear, but will, with every temptation, provide the way of escape also, so that you may be able to withstand.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:14
segments: So then, my beloved, continually flee from idolatry.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:15
segments: I am speaking to men of sense; do you yourselves judge what I say.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:16
segments: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not a common participation in the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not a common participation in the body of Christ?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:17
segments: Because we who are many are one bread, one body, for we all do share in the one loaf.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:18
segments: Look at Israel according to the flesh; are not those who eat the sacrifices in communion with the altar?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:19
segments: What then shall we say? that an offering to an idol is anything? or that an idol is really anything?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:20
segments: On the contrary, what the heathen sacrifice they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I do not want you to have communion with demons.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:21
segments: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and also the cup of demons; you cannot be partakers in the Lord's table and in the table of demons.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:22
segments: What! would we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:23
segments: "All things are lawful," you say? But not all things are expedient; "all things are lawful"; but not all build up.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:24
segments: Let not each one be always seeking his own, but rather his neighbor's good.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:25
segments: Eat anything that is for sale in the markets, asking no questions for conscience sake;

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:26
segments: for the earth and its fulness are the Lord's.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:27
segments: If one who is not a believer invites you to his house, and you wish to go, eat everything that is set before you, without asking questions for conscience sake.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:28
segments: But if any one tells you, "This food has been offered in sacrifice," do not eat it, for the sake of him who told you,

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:29
segments: and for your conscience sake--his conscience, not your own. "But," you may object, "why should my freedom be decided upon another's scruples of conscience?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:30
segments: If I eat after giving thanks, why am I denounced for eating that for which I have given thanks?"

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:31
segments: Because whether you are eating or whether you are drinking, you are to do it all for the glory of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:32
segments: Do not be a cause of stumbling either to Jews of to Gentiles, or to the church of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:33
segments: For so I also try to please all men in every way, not by seeking my own good, but the good of the many, that they may be saved.
